title: Arcane Index Reference: Troubleshooting
summary: Fix missing or stale Arcane Index pages by checking providers, discovery gates, and ids.

blocks.title: Common Failure
blocks.body: Missing pages usually mean a provider did not register, a discovery gate is hiding the entry, or the id changed between systems.

blocks.title: Refresh The Clue
blocks.body: Search with the exact item id or route id, then check nearby category pages if the direct page is not visible.

blocks.title: One Fix At A Time
blocks.body: Repair provider registration before rewriting content. A good provider with one page is easier to trust than a large copied catalog.

blocks.title: Retest Cleanly
blocks.body: Change one variable, test on a smaller route, and keep the fix only if the failure becomes easier to explain.
